name: NexoWatt EOS Admin
fixes: restore stable original Admin module-federation entry/assets instead of custom DPWrite entry bundles
remove passive/active performance guard injection that caused duplicate HTML5Backend errors
disable EOS DOM click capture for datapoint values; native ObjectBrowser handles clicks again
read-only state objects with common.write=false are no longer treated as writable in expert mode
writable state objects with common.write=true/common.write not false open the native value dialog
ObjectBrowserValue returns changes through the native ObjectBrowser onClose/onUpdate path instead of bypassing it
switch states still use robust boolean parsing so string false/0 do not get stuck
delete/logquiet/role-guard behavior from earlier fixes is preserved
notes: The v50-v53 DPWrite module-federation replacements and performance guard are not used. Datapoint writability follows ioBroker common.write: read registers with write=false stay read-only, write/command registers with write=true remain editable.
description: Restores the stable native ioBroker ObjectBrowser datapoint flow while preserving the NexoWatt EOS design and role/delete fixes.
